question:
Two orientations of a dice are shown. This dice can be obtained by folding which of the option figures along the lines?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fee5e03d2f8143243e7b40eb220d2af71de53efa872908204a3cb7fbd93ce5e.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Both the positions of the dice have a common face → L

Rotating clockwise direction from L in both, we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9592cf578aa3a24e41fe4d51fe5ef7735591b49b3f64f9496836e0a0f522e781.png] 

 
 

 
 
**Position 1 of Dice**

 
 
 
**L**

 
 
 
**O**

 
 
 
**P**

 
 
 

 
 
**Position 2 of Dice**

 
 
 
**L**

 
 
 
**N**

 
 
 
**Q**

 
 
 

The faces that will be opposite to each other when the paper is folded to form a cube is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/200dd8677dad1eefdb94b09d8130aaff3f4033d4666dd785b3403fe8446c9cc7.png] 

Hence, '**option 4**' is the correct answer.
